items.title: Visa (V) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift After Strong Q3 Analyst Revisions
items.summary: Visa’s fair value estimate has shifted from US$398.83 to US$411.63, giving investors fresh context for where some analysts now see the stock’s long term potential. The change sits alongside bullish commentary that focuses on recent fiscal Q3 results, payments volume trends, and what these analysts view as growth opportunities in value added services and stablecoin related products.
